topPRs.title: kona-node,kona-engine,kona-node-service!: share config and clients
topPRs.author: joshklop
topPRs.body:
Kona applies registry/file overrides and custom-chain settings consistently, and startup uses the same bounded L1/L2 clients as engine operations and ordinary reads. Explicit L2 timeouts cover complete responses, including stalled bodies; the 10,000ms default preserves the previous effective engine deadline. Configured block-signing key files must exist and contain a valid key instead of silently creating a replacement.

Stacked on #23484. Addresses the timeout portion of #23034; its discovery and peer requirements remain open.

BREAKING CHANGE: Rust callers replace `EngineClientBuilder`/`OpEngineClient::rpc_client` with `l1_provider`/`l2_provider` and `OpEngineClient::new(l1, l2, config)`. `RollupNodeBuilder` takes `Arc<RollupConfig>`; `EngineConfig` drops duplicate rules/L1 URL and takes an explicit timeout. `NetworkConfig` contains local settings, while `NetworkBuilder::from_config` receives resolved rules and a signer watch receiver. Updated operator examples show the new construction path. CLI flags, aliases and JWT fallback remain supported.

Validation: 327 affected-package Rust tests and all six live validator/sequencer checks pass, with no skips. Full workspace Rust lint and a fresh default-feature binary build pass. Independent Rust and deletion/config reviews have no unresolved findings; the committed plan records commands and evidence.
